sentence: Mi neniom plu povas elteni tiun bruon.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by GrizaLeono (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: I can't stand that noise any longer.

usageExamples: Mi demandas min kial karaokeo estas tiel populara.
I wonder why karaoke is so popular.
Sentence from Tatoeba by etala (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
Mi bezonas pli ofte veni ĉi tien.
I need to come here more often.
Sentence from Tatoeba by shekitten (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
Mi ne povas fidi al John pri mia aŭto.
I can't trust John with my car.
Sentence from Tatoeba by mamduhi (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
Nia bovino donas neniom da lakto al ni.
Our cow doesn't give us any milk.
Sentence from Tatoeba by soweli_Elepanto (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
Donu al li neniom de tiu supo.
Don't give him any of that soup.
Sentence from Tatoeba by GrizaLeono (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
Post tiu okazaĵo li neniam plu drinkis.
After that incident, he never drank again.
Sentence from Tatoeba by Vortarulo (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
Lasu min plu rakonti al vi pri tio.
Let me tell you more about it.

Why can't you do something about that?
Sentence from Tatoeba by soweli_Elepanto (CC-BY 2.0 FR)

You can also do this.

Nothing good can come of all this.

translations: to withstand, to endure, to persevere
usageExamples: Kelkaj homoj ne povas elteni la mondon.
Some people cannot cope with the world.
